out_of_hospital_midwife.kit_ordering: Out-of-hospital providers (midwives) order newborn screening collection cards and tubes through the Arizona State Laboratory (ADHS). Supplies are ordered via the ADHS Newborn Screening supply request process.
out_of_hospital_midwife.submission_deadline: Blood specimen collected 24-48 hours of age; repeat screen required if first collected before 24 hours.
out_of_hospital_midwife.specimen_tracking: Results released to the ordering provider; parents receive results from their provider. Tracking through the ADHS Newborn Screening portal.

hearing_screening.program_name: Arizona Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
hearing_screening.out_of_hospital_path: Midwives perform point-of-care (POC) newborn hearing screening in the out-of-hospital setting and submit results; refusal documented on the screening paperwork / medical record.
hearing_screening.statute: A.R.S. ÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂ§ 36-694 (includes hearing); Arizona EHDI 1-3-6 benchmarks

cchd_screening.out_of_hospital_performer: The attending midwife performs pulse oximetry (CCHD) point-of-care in the out-of-hospital setting and documents it; refusal documented on the screening paperwork / medical record.
cchd_screening.statute: A.R.S. ÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂ§ 36-694 (critical congenital heart defect screening)

erythromycin_eye_ointment.waiver: A parent may object to prophylactic eye treatment; the attending professional documents the objection on the birth record. Arizona provides no separate waiver form beyond the documented informed refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.note: Prophylactic eye treatment applied shortly after birth to prevent ophthalmia neonatorum.

vitamin_k.note: Arizona does not mandate vitamin K; parental choice of oral, intramuscular shot, or decline, documented in the birth record.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.note: Birth dose reported to ASIIS by birthing facilities; infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers are referred for Hepatitis B case management.

gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Licensed midwives in Arizona provide gestational diabetes screening/counseling in prenatal care and refer for diagnostic testing when indicated.
gestational_diabetes.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.

group_b_strep.midwife_role: Licensed midwives offer GBS screening in late pregnancy and arrange intrapartum prophylaxis per protocol for out-of-hospital births when indicated.
group_b_strep.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.
